description: For approved scouts: their personal link to invite other scouts (https://www.productclank.com/scouts?invite=<code>), plus who joined through it and where each one is (building / pending / approved / declined; active = approved and has sent a deal reply). Free, read-only. Invited scouts are reviewed like everyone else. Someone they invite can also apply from their own assistant with apply_as_scout and the invite code.
name: get_scout_invite_link
title: Get my scout invite link
